title: A unique steepest gain-loss interval can be a noise artifact rather than a recoverability knee

attack.raw_max_rule: selects interval [2,3] because -0.22 is uniquely most negative
attack.interpretation: the apparent knee is created by tiny deviations around an approximately constant decline

repair: treat raw argmax as exploratory only
predeclare a minimum slope-contrast or model-comparison criterion before observing candidate outcomes
require the transition region to replicate in held-out donors/independent data
compare explicit smooth/no-knee models against knee/change-point models instead of assuming a change point exists
non_equivalences: cross-validated knee != clinical cutoff without external validation
claim_boundary: HF-SIM-040 remains an operational target definition. HF-SIM-041 blocks treating a raw maximum in noisy finite data as FRK evidence.
